WHAT WE DO

A specialist partner,
never a CV agency.

We know that every career move or leadership hire is more than a transaction. That is why we take the time to listen, map markets discreetly, and advise both clients and candidates across all UK commercial, operational and leadership sectors.

Combining cross-sector commercial depth with disciplined research, we deliver the search rigour of an international executive firm alongside the personal accountability of a dedicated partner working exclusively for one organisation per sector at a time.

Where agreed, we connect that appointment to workplace coaching and seven human-controlled business platforms so new hires and regional teams sustain margin, follow-up speed and clear customer ownership.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked
Questions.

Straightforward answers covering our written sector exclusivity, cross-sector coverage, coaching and connected AI services.

Do you offer sector exclusivity — and how is it agreed?

Yes. Where single-client exclusivity is agreed in writing, we commit not to headhunt for named direct competitors within your agreed scope, sector and territory for the duration of the partnership. Request a manual review on our Sector & Territory Exclusivity page.

Do you specialise in one industry, or work across all UK sectors?

We are not limited to a single industry or niche. We partner with ambitious organisations across any UK commercial, operational or executive sector — our methodology is built around competitor mapping, leadership vetting and commercial execution in your market.

How is confidentiality maintained during a senior or passive search?

Every mandate runs under bilateral NDA protocols. We never publish client identities on job boards or approach a candidate’s employer without consent, protecting both client strategy and candidate confidentiality.

Can we engage Power-Up Talent for headhunting alone, or add coaching and AI services later?

Yes. Many clients start with a single critical search (Headhunting) and add leadership coaching (Coaching) or any of our seven AI & business platforms as their business grows.

How do the seven AI & business platforms fit alongside your people services?

Each of the seven platforms is a separate, human-controlled operational tool covering Sales & Intelligence, Business & Personal CRM, Shared Communications, Business Delivery, Automation (including the Live in Power CRM briefing), AI Team and Marketing & Social Media. Explore them on the AI Business Services hub.
